_comment: Instruction/call ceilings for the CSV framing loop, staged writers and getString in the csv_profile image (x86-64, -O2, -march=compatibility). Pinned on 2026-11-08 from the WS10 final image (afa4aa5) with ~10% headroom; a change that lowers a value re-pins it downward (never upward without a ledger ruling). Before WS10: frameFused 7,750/296, frameSpans 3,252/118, framePlain 1,133/25, stringAt 102/8 (beat-stock-svm ledger, WS10). WS10b (2026-11-09) removed Numbers.dot (153/4) with the word-path FLOAT64 conversion and re-pinned convertDoubles from 1,414 to 1,321 instructions; Numbers_shortDecimal/longDecimal/parseDouble are pinned from that image. Shape only; timings come from csv_pair.
